note: Revision 2 of the sheet draft of the fixture rheometer request (the person, 2026-11-09: correlations are value skills with a cited source, not a pinned package). The sample is water at the sample temperature; its viscosity and density are rows that value skills give, each marked a correlation, and the viscosity stands twice, from two sources, with the difference as a row of its own. The instrument does not exist; its figures are the specification section of meta_agent/tests/fixtures/rheometer/README.md, and tool_ref names the registry's lab_rheometer because the fixture stands in for it until its model is known (plan.md 14-21). No point is chosen: an interval is what the skills give, and the point inside it is tasks/011's.
